name: The Chain - A Fleetwood Mac Experience

evidence.note: Bay Street Theater page: Oct 3, 8 pm tribute concert, band lineup, return after a sold-out show.
Band video page includes a clip from a sold-out Bay Street Theater show.

dancing.notes: A seated theater tribute concert; people listen and sing along to the hits.

description: Long Island tribute band that recreates the songs of Fleetwood Mac and Stevie Nicks, playing theaters, libraries and outdoor concerts in New York, New Jersey and Pennsylvania.
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Several bands use the name 'The Chain' (e.g., thechainband.com, thechainrocks.com). This is the Long Island group whose site shows Bay Street Theater videos. Its site sits behind a browser check, so socials were not collected.

Directory research 2026-10-04: The site no longer shows a browser check, so socials were collected this time. Phone is the booking agency's (RJM Entertainment), as the band publishes it for bookings; email is the band's own published address. Bandsintown artist page: https://www.bandsintown.com/a/15489431-the-chain-a-fleetwood-mac-experience (not fetched; blocked). No Instagram linked from the site. The site's tour page loads shows from Bandsintown by script, so no upcoming dates could be read. Several photo-gallery items are phone screenshots of Facebook/messages; those were skipped. Current description is accurate; not replaced.
